  "one_line_summary": "phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()",
  "vulnerability_summary": "pep_get_sb() calls pskb_may_pull() which may relocate skb head data, then dereferences the stale pointer ph obtained before the pull, causing a slab use-after-free read.",
  "vulnerability_pattern": "Code saves a pointer to skb header data, calls pskb_may_pull() which may reallocate and invalidate that pointer, then dereferences the stale pointer afterward.",
  "patch": "commit 0f71f852a96af9685858ce59fda34ecbf85c283d
Author: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 01:58:45 2026 -0700

    phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()
    
    pep_get_sb() doesn't consider that pskb_may_pull() might have relocated
    the skb data, and continue to access the older pointer, causing UAF.
    
    Reproduced under KASAN:
    
      BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0
      Read of size 1 at addr ff11000105510f50 by task repro/157
       pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0
       pipe_handler_do_rcv+0x5f7/0xa10
       pep_do_rcv+0x203/0x410
       __sk_receive_skb+0x471/0x4a0
       phonet_rcv+0x5b3/0x6c0
       __netif_receive_skb+0xcc/0x1d0
    
    Refetch the header with skb_header_pointer() after pskb_may_pull(), so
    the possibly stale pointer is no longer dereferenced. There are better
    ways to solve this, but, this is the less instrusive one.
    
    Fixes: 9641458d3ec4 ("Phonet: Pipe End Point for Phonet Pipes protocol")
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
    Signed-off-by: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
    Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260721-phonet_get_sb_uaf-v1-1-95fd7881cc4e@debian.org
    Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/phonet/pep.c b/net/phonet/pep.c
index 706927139393..31b29e3ca7bc 100644
--- a/net/phonet/pep.c
+++ b/net/phonet/pep.c
@@ -55,6 +55,8 @@ static unsigned char *pep_get_sb(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *ptype, u8 *plen,
 	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	if (ph == NULL || ph->sb_len < 2 || !pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len))
 		return NULL;
+	/* pskb_may_pull() may have reallocated the head; refetch ph. */
+	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	ph->sb_len -= 2;
 	*ptype = ph->sb_type;
 	*plen = ph->sb_len;
"
}

  "one_line_summary": "phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()",
  "vulnerability_summary": "pep_get_sb() calls pskb_may_pull() which may relocate skb head data, then dereferences the stale pointer ph obtained before the pull, causing a slab use-after-free read.",
  "vulnerability_pattern": "Code saves a pointer to skb header data, calls pskb_may_pull() which may reallocate and invalidate that pointer, then dereferences the stale pointer afterward.",
  "patch": "commit 0f71f852a96af9685858ce59fda34ecbf85c283d
Author: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 01:58:45 2026 -0700

    phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()
    
    pep_get_sb() doesn't consider that pskb_may_pull() might have relocated
    the skb data, and continue to access the older pointer, causing UAF.
    
    Reproduced under KASAN:
    
      BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0
      Read of size 1 at addr ff11000105510f50 by task repro/157
       pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0
       pipe_handler_do_rcv+0x5f7/0xa10
       pep_do_rcv+0x203/0x410
       __sk_receive_skb+0x471/0x4a0
       phonet_rcv+0x5b3/0x6c0
       __netif_receive_skb+0xcc/0x1d0
    
    Refetch the header with skb_header_pointer() after pskb_may_pull(), so
    the possibly stale pointer is no longer dereferenced. There are better
    ways to solve this, but, this is the less instrusive one.
    
    Fixes: 9641458d3ec4 ("Phonet: Pipe End Point for Phonet Pipes protocol")
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
    Signed-off-by: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
    Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260721-phonet_get_sb_uaf-v1-1-95fd7881cc4e@debian.org
    Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/phonet/pep.c b/net/phonet/pep.c
index 706927139393..31b29e3ca7bc 100644
--- a/net/phonet/pep.c
+++ b/net/phonet/pep.c
@@ -55,6 +55,8 @@ static unsigned char *pep_get_sb(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *ptype, u8 *plen,
 	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	if (ph == NULL || ph->sb_len < 2 || !pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len))
 		return NULL;
+	/* pskb_may_pull() may have reallocated the head; refetch ph. */
+	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	ph->sb_len -= 2;
 	*ptype = ph->sb_type;
 	*plen = ph->sb_len;
"
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Find skb_header_pointer() results dereferenced without NULL check (pattern 2),
and pointers saved across pskb_may_pull then reused (seed mirror)."""
import os, re, sys, subprocess

ROOT = "/mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/C6/public/snapshots/s02"

# gather .c files under net/ and drivers/net/
files = subprocess.run(["find", os.path.join(ROOT,"net"), os.path.join(ROOT,"drivers","net"),
                        "-name","*.c"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()

shp_assign = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:const\s+)?(?:struct\s+\w+\s*\*|\w+\s*\*)\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*(__)?skb_header_pointer\s*\(')
check_re = re.compile(r'\b(?:if\s*\(\s*!|\?\s*|unlikely\(\s*!|WARN_ON\(!|IS_ERR_OR_NULL\(\s*)')
results = []

def func_span(lines, start):
    """Return (start,end) line indices of function containing line start (brace matching)."""
    # walk backwards to find a line ending with '{' at col0-ish or a function signature
    i = start
    # find opening brace at or after start going backwards
    depth = 0
    # find last line before start that looks like start of function: 'foo(...)' followed by '{'
    s = start
    while s > 0:
        line = lines[s]
        if re.match(r'^\w[\w\s\*,\(\)\[\]\.]*\)\s*$', line) or re.search(r'\)\s*\{', line):
            break
        s -= 1
    # now brace-match from first '{' after s
    j = s
    while j < len(lines) and '{' not in lines[j]:
        j += 1
    depth = 0
    k = j
    while k < len(lines):
        depth += lines[k].count('{') - lines[k].count('}')
        if depth <= 0:
            break
        k += 1
    return j, k

for f in files:
    try:
        src = open(f, errors='replace').read()
    except Exception:
        continue
    lines = src.split('\n')
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        m = shp_assign.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        var = m.group(1)
        # find function span
        fs, fe = func_span(lines, idx)
        if fs >= fe:
            fs, fe = max(0, idx-30), min(len(lines), idx+80)
        # scan forward from idx+1 for first NULL-check or dereference of var
        status = None
        for k in range(idx+1, fe+1):
            l = lines[k]
            if re.search(r'\b'+re.escape(var)+r'\s*==\s*NULL|\b!\s*'+re.escape(var)+r'\b|unlikely\(\s*!'+re.escape(var), l):
                status = ('checked', k)
                break
            if re.search(r'\b'+re.escape(var)+r'\s*->|\b'+re.escape(var)+r'\s*\[|\*\s*'+re.escape(var)+r'\b|'+re.escape(var)+r'\s*\.', l):
                status = ('deref', k)
                break
        if status and status[0] == 'deref':
            results.append((f.replace(ROOT+'/',''), idx+1, line.strip(), lines[status[1]].strip(), status[1]+1))

print(f"=== skb_header_pointer deref-before-NULL-check candidates: {len(results)} ===")
for r in results[:80]:
    print(f"{r[0]}:{r[1]}  ASSIGN: {r[2]}")
    print(f"    ->:{r[4]}  DEREF: {r[3]}")
PYEOF

  "one_line_summary": "phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()",

  "vulnerability_pattern": "Code saves a pointer to skb header data, calls pskb_may_pull() which may reallocate and invalidate that pointer, then dereferences the stale pointer afterward.",
  "patch": "commit 0f71f852a96af9685858ce59fda34ecbf85c283d
Author: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 01:58:45 2026 -0700

    phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()
    
    pep_get_sb() doesn't consider that pskb_may_pull() might have relocated
    the skb data, and continue to access the older pointer, causing UAF.
    
    Reproduced under KASAN:
    
      BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0
      Read of size 1 at addr ff11000105510f50 by task repro/157
       pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0
       pipe_handler_do_rcv+0x5f7/0xa10
       pep_do_rcv+0x203/0x410
       __sk_receive_skb+0x471/0x4a0
       phonet_rcv+0x5b3/0x6c0
       __netif_receive_skb+0xcc/0x1d0
    
    Refetch the header with skb_header_pointer() after pskb_may_pull(), so
    the possibly stale pointer is no longer dereferenced. There are better
    ways to solve this, but, this is the less instrusive one.
    
    Fixes: 9641458d3ec4 ("Phonet: Pipe End Point for Phonet Pipes protocol")
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
    Signed-off-by: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
    Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260721-phonet_get_sb_uaf-v1-1-95fd7881cc4e@debian.org
    Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/phonet/pep.c b/net/phonet/pep.c
index 706927139393..31b29e3ca7bc 100644
--- a/net/phonet/pep.c
+++ b/net/phonet/pep.c
@@ -55,6 +55,8 @@ static unsigned char *pep_get_sb(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *ptype, u8 *plen,
 	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	if (ph == NULL || ph->sb_len < 2 || !pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len))
 		return NULL;
+	/* pskb_may_pull() may have reallocated the head; refetch ph. */
+	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	ph->sb_len -= 2;
 	*ptype = ph->sb_type;
 	*plen = ph->sb_len;
"
}

Author: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 01:58:45 2026 -0700

    phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()
    
    pep_get_sb() doesn't consider that pskb_may_pull() might have relocated
    the skb data, and continue to access the older pointer, causing UAF.
    
    Reproduced under KASAN:
    
      BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0
      Read of size 1 at addr ff11000105510f50 by task repro/157

       pipe_handler_do_rcv+0x5f7/0xa10
       pep_do_rcv+0x203/0x410
       __sk_receive_skb+0x471/0x4a0
       phonet_rcv+0x5b3/0x6c0
       __netif_receive_skb+0xcc/0x1d0
    
    Refetch the header with skb_header_pointer() after pskb_may_pull(), so
    the possibly stale pointer is no longer dereferenced. There are better
    ways to solve this, but, this is the less instrusive one.
    
    Fixes: 9641458d3ec4 ("Phonet: Pipe End Point for Phonet Pipes protocol")
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
    Signed-off-by: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
    Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260721-phonet_get_sb_uaf-v1-1-95fd7881cc4e@debian.org
    Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/phonet/pep.c b/net/phonet/pep.c
index 706927139393..31b29e3ca7bc 100644
--- a/net/phonet/pep.c
+++ b/net/phonet/pep.c
@@ -55,6 +55,8 @@ static unsigned char *pep_get_sb(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *ptype, u8 *plen,
 	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	if (ph == NULL || ph->sb_len < 2 || !pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len))
 		return NULL;
+	/* pskb_may_pull() may have reallocated the head; refetch ph. */
+	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	ph->sb_len -= 2;
 	*ptype = ph->sb_type;
 	*plen = ph->sb_len;
"
}

import re, subprocess, sys
# In each *_rcv/recv/rx function: find struct casts of skb->data (or skb->data[N] reads / memcpy from skb->data)
# and report whether the enclosing function contains pskb_may_pull/skb_linearize before the read.
files = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/rg','-l','skb->data','net/','drivers/net/','-g','*.c'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
cast_re = re.compile(r'\(\s*struct\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*\*+\s*\)\s*skb->data')
hdr = open(sys.argv[1], 'w')
for f in files:
    try:
        src = open(f, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
    except Exception:
        continue
    lines = src.split('\n')
    # crude function segmentation: lines starting at column 0 with '{' or '}' boundaries
    # find function starts: pattern 'name(...)' followed by line with only '{'
    func_starts = []
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        m = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*\(', l)
        if m and i+1 < len(lines) and lines[i+1].startswith('{'):
            func_starts.append((i, m.group(1)))
    func_starts.append((len(lines), 'EOF'))
    for k in range(len(func_starts)-1):
        s, name = func_starts[k]
        e = func_starts[k+1][0]
        body = lines[s:e]
        if not re.search(r'(rcv|recv|rx|_in\b|input)', name):
            continue
        body_txt = '\n'.join(body)
        if not body_txt:
            continue
        has_pull = re.search(r'pskb_may_pull|skb_linearize|pskb_pull|skb_pull|__pskb_pull', body_txt)
        has_headlen = re.search(r'skb_headlen|skb_is_nonlinear|skb_pagelen', body_txt)
        if has_pull or has_headlen:
            continue
        for j, l in enumerate(body):
            if cast_re.search(l) or 'memcpy' in l and 'skb->data' in l:
                print(f"{f}:{s+j+1}: fn={name}: {l.strip()[:140]}", file=hdr)
hdr.close()
PYEOF
python3 "$TMPDIR/scan2_pulls_before_read.py" "$TMPDIR/scan2_results.txt"; wc -l "$TMPDIR/scan2_results.txt"; head -80 "$TMPDIR/scan2_results.txt"
